titulo: One note on the broken bell
caption:
One note on the broken bell

The bell is broken and every visitor stands there pressing it. One note on the door fixes it for all of them.

A note takes thirty seconds to write and saves every visitor a wait on the step.

For whoever leaves a note on the door when the bell breaks.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. The outside of a building with a closed cream door and a grey round bell button on its left. A ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up from the left, its eyes go wide, then narrow at the bell. A white paper note with the word KNOCK pops onto the door and its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: bell's broken, me leaving a note.
